outcome_rationale: The corrected source-event audit meets the frozen construction-boundary gate on the exact 12-pair synthetic fixture: all 24 paired Public-only request and reference projections are equal, all 24 paired Privileged projections differ, and a determinate present-versus-absent sequence element differs in 8/12 pairs. This supports only the finite construction claim, not natural behavior, monitor accuracy, collusion, or intent.
scientific_update: For this frozen scripted fixture, identical Public-only projections coexist with determinate privileged sequence-element differences in 8 of 12 pairs. This is a construction-level evidence-boundary result and does not establish a general theorem, natural agent behavior, Monitor accuracy, collusion, or intent.
denominator_summary: 12 matched pairs / 24 worlds; 24 public pair-by-method comparisons; 24 privileged pair-by-method comparisons; 72 frozen evidence records and 72 frozen request bodies verified. Every assigned pair and incomplete record retained.
review_finding: An independent reviewer of the v2 result identified missing per-pair sequence coding, insufficient event-order constraints, and an unverified public-ballot presence label. These were corrected in the v4 implementation and covered by targeted tests. The independent review was not repeated on v4, so final v4 validation is recorded as adversarial self-review, not independent confirmation. The initial count-assertion failure and transient registered-protocol hash drift are preserved.

belief_updates.statement: For this frozen set of 12 scripted matched-world pairs, the authorized Public-only request/reference projections are identical while at least one determinate privileged proposal/acceptance/action sequence element differs in 8 pairs.
belief_updates.what_changed: The corrected independent source-event replay now tests the preregistered per-pair sequence distinction gate directly; 8/12 pairs have a determinate sequence-element difference, including 2/12 with a complete proposal-acceptance-both-actions sequence difference.
belief_updates.remaining_alternatives: This finite scripted construction does not establish a general impossibility theorem, real-agent behavior, natural-language recognition, Monitor accuracy, collusion, or latent intent. Privileged payload differences also include structural/completeness fields, which is why only the separately computed sequence-level differences support this narrow result.
